source.lo_text: Provide an example of the intermediate value theorem.

front.title: Intermediate Value
front.subtitle: No Skipped Values

central.text: A continuous function takes every value between its two endpoint values.

front.main_description: An unbroken graph must hit every height in between.
front.supporting_description: If the curve starts below a target and ends above it, it crossed.

back.title: Worked Example

problem.v: Is there a solution between 1 and 4?

segments.v: The graph is continuous with no breaks.
At the left end the value is below zero.
At the right end the value is above zero.
Zero lies between those two heights.
A solution is guaranteed between 1 and 4.

back.footer: Continuity guarantees every in between value is reached.
